data.summary: The pod startup was delayed primarily by the application downloading 500 MB of model weights during initialisation. This process took 53.7 seconds, accounting for the majority of the 86.0-second total startup time. While the image pull was also slower than expected, the model download is the dominant factor in the SLO breach.

findings.statement: The model download phase took 53.7 seconds to retrieve 524 MB of data.
The total application initialisation time was 55.1 seconds, which is significantly higher than the 10.0-second SLO threshold.
The image pull took 29.5 seconds for 53 MB, indicating a throughput of 1.8 MB/s, which is below the 5 MB/s threshold.

ruled_out.reason: Although the image pull was slow at 1.8 MB/s, the model download duration of 53.7 seconds was the primary contributor to the total startup time of 86.0 seconds.
Scheduling duration was 0.0 seconds, indicating no delay in pod placement.

recommendations.rationale: The application currently downloads 524 MB of weights on every cold start, which is the primary bottleneck.
The image pull throughput was only 1.8 MB/s, which is below the expected 5 MB/s threshold.
